[EN] Fallen, but Not Forgotten
[ES] Caídos, pero no olvidados
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We can't just leave them out there.
[ES] No podemos simplemente dejarles ahí fuera.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I'll see you in Pareseshan, brothers.
[ES] Nos vemos en Pareseshan, hermanos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Rest well, my friend."
[ES] "Descansa bien, amigo mío."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I honor your sacrifice."
[ES] "Honro vuestro sacrificio."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'll get you home."
[ES] "Te llevaré a casa."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "May Kaia honor you."
[ES] "Que Kaia te honre."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Retrieve the horns from the slain blacksmiths.
[ES] Recupera los cuernos de los herreros caídos.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Amani Horn
[ES] Cuerno de Amani
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Deliver the horns to Chatran.
[ES] Entrega los cuernos a Chatran.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I'm glad I could help."
[ES] "Me alegra haber podido ayudar."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
